name: Taxi Boss
creator: Taxi Boss Group
redeem: Launch Taxi Boss on Roblox and wait for your character to load into the city.
Click the Shop button, a shopping cart icon in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
Click the box labelled Enter Code in the shop window.
Type or paste the code with the exact capitalization and press the gray Enter button.
notes:
Taxi Boss is an open-city driving game made by olikus400, Bertik750 and SamSpeedCz. You pick up passengers, get them to their destination as fast as you can for a bigger fare, and spend the money on new cars, performance parts and visual mods such as wheels, spoilers, lights and paint. Faster cars let you take higher-paying customers, and you can also upgrade a garage to display your collection.

Most Taxi Boss codes give cash, usually between 1,000 and 5,000, which gets you to your first car or upgrade sooner. Codes released with balance updates have also handed out parts like turbos. The developers tie codes to like milestones, with the description promising the next one at 800K likes, and post them on Discord and X.

faq.q: When will the next Taxi Boss code be released?
faq.a: The game description says the next code will drop when Taxi Boss reaches 800K likes. The current like-milestone code, THX600K, was released to celebrate 600K likes.

faq.q: Where do I enter codes in Taxi Boss?
faq.a: Click the shopping cart Shop button in the bottom-left corner, then click the Enter Code box. Type the code with the exact capitalization and press the gray Enter button.

faq.q: What can I spend Taxi Boss code cash on?
faq.a: Cash buys new cars, performance parts and visual mods such as wheels, spoilers, lights and paint. Customers pay more the quicker you get them to their destination, so faster cars earn bigger fares.

tips: Take the fastest route you can find. Fares go up the quicker you deliver, so learning the city streets pays off fast.
Spend early money on performance parts before looks. Paint and lights are fun, but a faster car is what earns bigger fares.
Go for better customers once your car can handle them. They pay more than regular riders, which is how the game works like a tycoon.
Upgrade your garage once you own a few cars. It lets you display your best cars and shows how far your collection has come.
useRewards: Both working codes give 1,000 cash, so you get 2,000 in total. Redeem them on your first drive and put the money toward a faster car or a performance part, since speed is what raises your fares. Save cosmetic mods for later. Codes from balance updates have also given parts like turbos, and those are worth fitting to your car right away.
